adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#13
adds.text: In Siberia, Mack sends Bobbi after Androvich while he carries Daisy out. When Bobbi and Hunter are disavowed, Mack stays behind at the bar after the others leave and cries with Bobbi over their goodbye.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Mack's old friend, who leaves S.H.I.E.L.D. after Siberia.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Bobbi's old friend, who cries at her goodbye.
adds.evidence: AoS S3#13 Parting Shot: Mack urges Morse to go kill Androvich while he takes Johnson back to Zephyr One; at Teddy's Bar Mackenzie stays, shares a shot and cries, and Morse cries as he leaves.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#21
adds.text: Mack tells Daisy, freed from Hive and in containment, that he forgives her for nearly killing him, and holds her as she breaks down in tears.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A close friend Mack forgives after Hive's hold breaks.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend who forgives Daisy and hugs her.
adds.evidence: AoS S3#21 Absolution: Mackenzie visits Johnson in the containment chamber, says he has forgiven her for the Union City attack (S3#19) and hugs her as she bursts into tears.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#22
adds.text: Trapped by Primitives, Mack and Radcliffe shelter together, and over Mack's objections Radcliffe has a blowtorch used to seal Yo-Yo's wound.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A scientist who shelters with Mack from the Primitives.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who shelters with Radcliffe and argues over Yo-Yo's wound.
adds.evidence: AoS S3#22 Ascension: Radcliffe, Coulson and Campbell hide in a room, Mackenzie arrives carrying the wounded Rodriguez; Radcliffe proposes the blowtorch despite Mackenzie's objections, and they trade lines about the heating ('a science hunch').

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#18
adds.text: After the mission to find Radcliffe in Bucharest, Mack tells a shaken Jemma that her bond with Fitz is not new, since the two have been close for years, and she smiles.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who reassures Jemma about Fitz.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who confides in Mack about Fitz.
adds.evidence: AoS S3#18 The Singularity: Mackenzie, sent to Romania with Fitz and Simmons, talks with Simmons in the hotel room about her relationship with Fitz, saying they have been close for years.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#13
adds.text: When Hunter and Bobbi are disavowed, Mack stays behind at the bar after the others leave and cries over his friends' goodbye.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A close friend Mack cries for when he leaves.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend who cries at Hunter's goodbye.
adds.evidence: AoS S3#13 Parting Shot: at Teddy's Bar, in the 'spy's goodbye' to Hunter and Morse, Mackenzie stays after the rest walk out and cries over the leaving of his friends.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#17
adds.text: Trapped in a storeroom of Malick's base, Mack and Fitz work together to hold off Lucio's men until the Secret Warriors arrive.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who holds off Lucio's men with Mack.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who holds off Lucio's men with Fitz.
adds.evidence: AoS S3#17 The Team: Mackenzie and Fitz help the wounded May into a storage room and find a way to keep Lucio and his men at bay until the Secret Warriors rescue them.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#9
adds.text: Left as acting Director, Mack asks May for advice on Coulson's mission, and she tells him to make the call for Coulson, since he already knows what to do.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Mack turns to for advice as acting Director.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who asks May's advice as acting Director.
adds.evidence: AoS S3#9 Closure: acting director Mackenzie calls May to his office for advice; she tells him to make the decision for Coulson about sending back-up.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#9
adds.text: After Price's death, Coulson makes Mack acting Director of S.H.I.E.L.D. while he goes after Ward on his own.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Mack's friend, who makes him acting Director.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's friend, left as acting Director.
adds.evidence: AoS S3#9 Closure: Coulson promotes Mack to interim director of S.H.I.E.L.D. and sets out for revenge on Ward.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#13
adds.text: In Siberia, Bobbi and Daisy snatch Androvich together, and after his shadow knocks Daisy out, Bobbi goes after him alone.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who seizes Androvich with Bobbi.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who seizes Androvich with Daisy.
adds.evidence: AoS S3#13 Parting Shot: Morse, Johnson and Mackenzie kidnap Androvich with a smoke bomb; the shadow knocks Johnson out and Morse runs after Androvich and kills him.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#12
adds.text: Bobbi objects when Talbot wants Creel along on the symposium mission, then fights Hydra's guards to reach Talbot and Coulson after Malick's men seize them.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A general whose plan to bring Creel Bobbi opposes.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who opposes Talbot's plan for Creel.
adds.evidence: AoS S3#12 The Inside Man: in Coulson's office Talbot pushes for Creel to join, and Morse disagrees since he is a murderer; at the symposium Morse and Hunter go to find Coulson and Talbot and fight Hydra agents with Creel's help.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#3
adds.text: Bobbi finds Jemma studying the Monolith's remains, and Jemma confides that she needs to go back to the alien planet.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A close friend who confides in Bobbi.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend Jemma confides in.
adds.evidence: AoS S3#3 A Wanted (Inhu)man: Morse finds Simmons examining the Monolith's remains; Simmons says it has to open, as she needs to go back. Wikipedia: 'Bobbi Morse finds Simmons wanting to reopen the portal and return to the planet.'

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#3
adds.text: Fitz tells Bobbi that Jemma seems distant, and Bobbi advises him to be patient and give her something new to look forward to.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who asks Bobbi how to help Jemma.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who advises Fitz on helping Jemma.
adds.evidence: AoS S3#3 A Wanted (Inhu)man: during Morse's knee rehab Fitz talks about Simmons being distant; Morse reminds him to be patient and to give her something new; Fitz thanks her.
